headline: Nour Private Management Acquires Mirabaud Canada Wealth Unit
summary: Nour Private Wealth has completed the acquisition of Mirabaud Canada's wealth management business to expand its private wealth platform for ultra-high-net-worth families and institutions.
why: Wealth management acquisitions reshape market share in the financial sector, altering competitive dynamics among private banks and advisory firms serving high-net-worth clients.

impacts.name: Nour Private Wealth Inc.
impacts.why: Acquiring a business expands its private wealth platform and client assets under management.
